### Share a Vision of Faith, Not Fear
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-february-2-2022.html
Passage: Numbers 13:30
Points:
- Approaching the future with fear causes people to underestimate God-given abilities and bury their talents.
- Ten spies focused on the giants and responded in fear, while Caleb and Joshua trusted God's promise.
- Fear fosters a defeating self-image and creates self-fulfilling negative forecasts that discourage others.
- Viewing challenges through eyes of faith empowers believers to step forward and accomplish God's call.

### Faithlessness Shrinks You Down To a Grasshopper
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/faithlessness-shrinks-you-down-to-a-grasshopper/
Passage: Numbers 13:33
Points:
- Holding an undersized view of God inflates perceived obstacles and shrinks how you view yourself.
- The ten spies labeled themselves grasshoppers because unbelief blinded them to God's power and promises.
- Underestimating your gifts and God-given role is not genuine humility, but a sign of faithlessness.
- Believers are called children of the King who can face formidable giants with confidence in God.
